newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S TOP RESTAURANTS SAID ON PAR WITH EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S TOP RESTAURANTS SAID ON PAR WITH EUROPE.

text.p: Hungary's best restaurants might be out of reach for the average Hungarian but they compete with anything in Europe, gastronomers said on Wednesday.

"The fact that Hungarian chefs finished on a tie with their Swiss counterparts, winning 17 gold medals at a recent 'Chef's Olympics', proves this," said Zoltan Komaromi, editor-in-chief of Hungary's Gastronomy magazine after announcing the magazine's top ten Hungarian restaurants.
The ten best eating places are not listed in any particular order, Komaromi said.
"There is no first among the best," Komaromi added.
However, four restaurants that have made the list three years in a row, the Admiralis, Fortuna, Gambrinus and the Gundel, received a three-year recommendation for consistent performance.
The Gundel's Imre Balaton told Reuters the restaurant offers dinner for two at around 16,000 forints ($100), almost half the average wage in Hungary.
"Roast pork fillet pigtail with wild mushroom stew and cheese dumplings is one of our specialities," he said.
Nine of the ten winners are from Budapest, with the Villa Medici, in Veszprem, in western Hungary, the only provincial establishment to make it on to the list.
